_meta.description: Targeted regulatory and commercial status follow-ups on active microreactor deployment candidate sites, docket numbers, and license instruments.

followups.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) KRONOS MMR
followups.entity: University of Illinois / Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation (USNC)
followups.regulatory_milestone: The NRC formally accepted and docketed UIUC's Construction Permit application on May 18, 2026 for the KRONOS test reactor facility. Environmental scoping and safety evaluation review schedule active.

sources.label: Federal Register — University of Illinois Construction Permit Application Acceptance (NRC-2026-1717)
sources.quote: accepted for docketing the application for a construction permit for the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign KRONOS test reactor

followups.name: Texas A&M RELLIS Campus / Energy Proving Ground
followups.entity: Texas A&M University System & Aalo Atomics
followups.regulatory_milestone: TAMUS announced selection of Aalo Atomics alongside Kairos, Natura, and Terrestrial Energy to build and test advanced reactors at RELLIS. NRC pre-application engagement under Docket 99902128 active.

sources.label: Texas A&M University System — Nuclear Energy Proving Ground at RELLIS
sources.quote: selected four companies—Aalo Atomics, Kairos Power, Natura Resources, and Terrestrial Energy—to build and test advanced reactors

sources.label: NRC ADAMS — Aalo Atomics Pre-application Docket 99902128

followups.name: Copper Valley Electric Association (CVEA) Microreactor Project
followups.entity: Copper Valley Electric Association & Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation
followups.docket_number: Alaska RCA / CVEA Board Feasibility Resolution
followups.regulatory_milestone: CVEA completed comprehensive Alaska MMR Feasibility Study demonstrating direct economic displacement of diesel generation ($0.25–$0.40/kWh local retail rates) and heavy seasonal oil consumption.

sources.label: CVEA — Alaska MMR Feasibility Study Final Report
sources.quote: CVEA's isolated grid in Valdez and Copper River Basin currently relies on diesel generation during winter low-hydro months

followups.name: Katowice & Legnica Special Economic Zones (KSSE / LSSE)
followups.entity: Last Energy, Katowice SEZ, Legnica SEZ, DB Energy
followups.docket_number: Polish PAA Pre-licensing & SEZ Power Purchase Agreements
followups.regulatory_milestone: Last Energy executed commercial agreements to deploy up to 10 PWR-20 microreactors in Katowice SEZ (approx. $1B investment) and 10 units in Legnica SEZ with DB Energy for dedicated industrial baseload.

sources.label: Nuclear Engineering International — Last Energy signs agreement for 10 SMRs in Katowice SEZ
sources.quote: Last Energy will finance, build, and operate 10 PWR-20 units supplying industrial off-takers

sources.label: World Nuclear News — Polish industrial zones partner on microreactor deployment
sources.quote: DB Energy and Legnica Special Economic Zone cooperation agreement for 200 MWe microreactor capacity

followups.name: Eielson Air Force Base Microreactor Pilot
followups.entity: Department of the Air Force / Defense Logistics Agency
followups.regulatory_milestone: Air Force announced intention to award microreactor contract under 10 U.S.C. 2922a for 30-year utility service contract to provide firm baseload heat and power to Eielson AFB, replacing aging coal CHP infrastructure.

sources.label: U.S. Air Force — Eielson Microreactor Pilot Project Milestone
sources.quote: provides resilient, clean, and reliable energy for critical national security infrastructure
